tickets.title: Prepare liquidity destination note for Raina Bramblequill
tickets.text: Prepare a concise destination note for Raina Bramblequill covering operating cash, reserves, estimated taxes, investment staging, and CPA and attorney questions after the Cloudberry Kite Design Studio sale. Reflect the $2,765,000 Teacup Comet Bank deposit, the $4.6 million gross consideration, the $350,000 indemnity escrow holdback, and the $1.74 million in Velvet Acorn Custody accounts.
tickets.evidence: Raina asked for a concise destination note covering operating cash, reserves, estimated taxes, investment staging, and CPA and attorney questions; the agreed follow-up is due January 10, 2025.

tickets.title: Obtain executed escrow agreement and working-capital schedule
tickets.text: Obtain the executed escrow agreement and final working-capital schedule missing from Raina Bramblequill's Cloudberry Kite Design Studio sale file. These documents are needed to reconcile the $4.6 million gross consideration against the $2,765,000 Teacup Comet Bank deposit.
tickets.evidence: The agreed January 3, 2025 follow-up is to obtain the executed escrow agreement and final working-capital schedule missing from the sale file.
